title: The Hidden Sponsor Thread
description: Badges, shell vendors, staged logins, and a hidden sponsor connect every earlier scandal into one final case.

answerKey.method: Used a duplicate staff badge to move Lena’s emergency kit and frame Owen’s office login
answerKey.motive: To hide that she had been rerouting event deposits through a shell vendor
answerKey.keyEvidence: Duplicate badge access, shell vendor ledger, and metadata showing a staged Owen login
answerKey.explanation: Marisol built the strongest frame by making Owen’s login look responsible, but the badge audit shows a duplicate credential moving between the office and service hall. Her shell vendor ledger explains the motive, and the metadata proves the Owen login was staged after the fact.

openingNarration: Every thread now points back to the same hidden structure: Hidden Sponsor Thread, Bayou Night Logistics, staged logins, and duplicate access. The final case is still solved by evidence in this session, but the meaning is bigger. Someone did not just hide one murder. They built a system for hiding all of them.
revealScript:
Case closed. This was Level 5: Hard Case. The culprit was Marisol Vega. The method: Used a duplicate staff badge to move Lena’s emergency kit and frame Owen’s office login. The motive: To hide that she had been rerouting event deposits through a shell vendor. The proof: Duplicate badge access, shell vendor ledger, and metadata showing a staged Owen login.

Continuing Story Thread: Marisol is exposed as the person who rerouted deposits, staged access, and used the earlier suspects as cover. The larger Barfly Social Mystery arc closes here: Hidden Sponsor Thread was not a single clue. It was the operation behind the whole season.

lobbyBackstory: The final chapter of Mystery Series begins with a duplicate badge and a framed login. Every previous chapter pointed toward Hidden Sponsor Thread, but now the pattern is visible: moved evidence, staged records, shell vendors, and one person using the chaos to hide in plain sight. This is the most layered case in the series.
